# Draft:Battle of Mount Zozik

In 1965, the Iraqi army attacked Mount Zozik, but the Peshmerga, led by Haji Berokhi, launched a victorious counterattack. In 1966, a new Iraqi offensive was repelled by the forces of Massoud Barzani and Idris Barzani, inflicting 400 deaths on the enemy. This victory made Zozik a symbol of Kurdish resistance. Peshmerga
